passages.context: The heading repeats Otmar Nestroy's complete title 'Familiäres, oder: A generatione et progenie aus dem Hause Nestroy'. His abstract says that documents concerning the Nestroy family, seen while visiting his cousin, span 1828-1939 and comprise baptismal, marriage, and death certificates and family letters; he proposed presenting twenty-two of them as contributions to Nestroy family history.
passages.notes: This abstract establishes the title's genealogical context. It does not name the psalm or the Alleluia, characterize the title as a joke, or show that the conference itself was a family gathering.
